Gun Rights: Recognized individual right to possess firearms independent of militia service.
Incorporated the Second Amendment against state and local governments.
New York State Rifle & Pistol Assn. v. Bruen (2022)
Struck down NY concealed carry requirement; adopted historical tradition test.
Federal firearms ban for those under domestic violence restraining orders is constitutional.
Immigration & Citizenship: States may not deny public education to undocumented immigrant children.
Standard for asylum based on well-founded fear of persecution clarified.
Indefinite detention of deportable aliens after final removal order is unconstitutional.
Federal immigration law preempts most of Arizona's SB 1070; states cannot create own immigration enforcement.
Travel ban on predominantly Muslim countries upheld; Korematsu formally overruled.
Department of Homeland Security v. Regents of UC (2020)
DACA rescission was arbitrary and capricious; must be preserved.
Health Care & Regulatory Power: ACA individual mandate exceeds Commerce Clause; upheld as valid tax. Medicaid expansion coercive.
ACA subsidies available through federal exchanges as well as state exchanges.
Congress may prohibit personal marijuana cultivation under Commerce Clause.
EPA cannot mandate sweeping power sector transformation; major questions require clear congressional authority.
Chevron deference overruled; agencies no longer get deference on statutory interpretation.
